g1-implement.title: Fingerprint guard: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Implement the fingerprint guard. Specifically: (1) Create src/evo_predictor/gold_cycle/bundle_fingerprint.py with compute_bundle_fingerprint(args: argparse.Namespace) -> str (SHA256 of canonical JSON of the config keys: learning_rate, epochs, early_stop_patience, hidden_dim, dropout, optimizer, weight_decay, min_delta, session_dropout_k, session_dropout_session_prob, recent_history_form_encoding, qs_compound_beta_regime, lambda_sigma_nll, student_t_nu_sigma) and check_bundle_fingerprint(manifest_path: Path, expected_fp: str) -> tuple[bool, str] (reads 'cycle_fingerprint' from manifest, returns (match, reason) — missing key = (False, 'no fingerprint in bundle (legacy)')); (2) Update write_latent_power_module_bundle in src/evo_predictor/latent_power_bundle.py to accept an optional cycle_fingerprint: str | None = None kwarg and write it into the manifest as 'cycle_fingerprint' when provided; (3) Update cmd_train_latent_power_module in src/evo_predictor/run.py: after candidate_manifest.exists() check, call check_bundle_fingerprint(candidate_manifest, compute_bundle_fingerprint(args)); if (False, reason) log a WARNING 'REUSE SKIPPED: {reason} — retraining {candidate_manifest}' and fall through to retrain; if match, log '[reuse] fingerprint match' and return early; (4) Thread cycle_fingerprint=compute_bundle_fingerprint(args) through to write_latent_power_module_bundle call in cmd_train_latent_power_module; (5) Write unit tests in tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_gold_cycle_fingerprint.py: test fingerprint_match_reuses, test fingerprint_mismatch_retrains, test missing_fingerprint_legacy_retrains — all using synthetic fixture dirs (no real training). Environment variable GOLD_CYCLE_REUSE_EXISTING=1 must be set in the test via monkeypatch.
